title: The embryonic organizer
summary: In her 1923 dissertation, Hilde Mangold grafted embryo tissue to show that one region organises the whole body plan of a developing embryo.
why: Founded the study of how embryos pattern themselves.

unsung.contribution: Carried out the experiments that discovered the embryonic organizer.
unsung.recognition: She died in 1924; her mentor Hans Spemann won the 1935 Nobel Prize on the foundation of her thesis.
